words.root_logic: planus（平的）→ 表面无起伏 → 不加修饰的、一望便知的；名词指平地
words.origin: 古法语 plain，来自拉丁语 planus（平的）
words.native_definition: simple and without decoration; easy to understand; a large flat area
words.core_concept: a surface with nothing raised on it to catch the eye – 面上不起花样，一眼扫得到底
words.core_image: 一张白桌面从这头看到那头，什么摆件都没有
examples: She wore a plain grey dress.
It is plain that he was lying.
semantic_expansions: 朴素的：面上不加花样
清楚的：摊得平、一眼看到底
平原：地面无起伏的那一片
words.recall_hint: planus（平的）→ 面上不起花样、一眼见底

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ plain（平）→ 把褶皱摊平摊开 → 讲清楚
words.origin: 拉丁语 explanare（摊平、阐明），来自 ex＋planus（平的）
words.native_definition: to make something clear by describing it in detail
words.core_concept: smoothing the folds out so the whole lies open – 把折起来的一层层摊开，全貌就露出来
words.core_image: 他把揉成一团的那张纸一点点抹开，字迹才连得起来
examples: She explained her reasons at length.
semantic_expansions: 解释/说明/阐明：把褶皱摊平、使人看清
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ plain（平）→ 把褶子摊开讲清

words.root_logic: aero-（空气）+ plane（平面）→ 靠平展翼面浮在空气里的那件东西
words.origin: 法语 aéroplane，由希腊 aēr（空气）＋拉丁 planus（平面）合成
words.native_definition: a vehicle with wings and engines that flies through the air
words.core_concept: the craft held up by two flat faces pressed against the air – 靠两片平展的面撑住空气而浮起的器械
words.core_image: 两侧那两片薄薄的面一斜，整个机身就抬了起来
examples: The aeroplane took off on time.
He has never been on an aeroplane.
semantic_expansions: 飞机：靠平展翼面撑住空气而飞的器械
words.recall_hint: aero-（空气）+ plane（平面）→ 靠平展翼面浮起

words.root_logic: polis（城邦）→ politia（城邦治理）→ 维持城中秩序的那班人
words.origin: 法语 police，来自拉丁语 politia（治理）← 希腊语 politeia ← polis（城邦）
words.native_definition: the official force that keeps order and enforces the law
words.core_concept: the body charged with keeping the city's order – 受命看住全城秩序的那班人
words.core_image: 街口那几个人一站，闹哄哄的人群自己让出条路
examples: She called the police at once.
semantic_expansions: 警察/警方：受命维持城中秩序的那班人
words.recall_hint: polis（城邦）→ politia（治理）→ 维持城中秩序者

words.root_logic: police（维持秩序者）+ man（人）→ 其中一名
words.origin: 英语复合词 police＋man，police ← 拉丁语 politia ← 希腊语 polis
words.native_definition: a male member of the police force
words.core_concept: one man out of the body that keeps order – 看守秩序那班人里的一名男性
words.core_image: 路口那一位抬手一比，车流就停住了
examples: The policeman took down her name.
semantic_expansions: 警察/男警：维持秩序那班人里的一名男性
words.recall_hint: police（维持秩序者）+ man → 其中一名

words.root_logic: polis（城邦）→ politia（治理）→ 治理所定的那套方针
words.origin: 古法语 policie（治理），来自拉丁语 politia ← 希腊语 politeia ← polis
words.native_definition: a plan of action agreed by a government or organization
words.core_concept: the settled course by which a body is run – 治事者定下来照办的那条路子
words.core_image: 议事厅定下一条，往后各处照着这条办
semantic_expansions: 政策/方针：治事所定、往后照办的那条路子
保单：把承保条款定死的那纸文书
words.recall_hint: polis（城邦）→ politia（治理）→ 所定的方针

words.root_logic: metro-（mētēr 母）+ polit（城邦）+ -an → 属于母城、大城的
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 metropolitanus，来自希腊语 mētropolis（母城）← mētēr（母）＋polis（城邦）；与 metron（量度）无关，上一批从 metron 名下剔除是对的
words.native_definition: relating to a large city and the area around it
words.core_concept: belonging to the mother-city that other towns grew out of – 属于那座生出周边诸镇的母城
words.core_image: 地铁线从那座大城摊开，一路连出去几十个镇子
examples: He works for the metropolitan council.
It is a metropolitan area of ten million.
semantic_expansions: 大都市的/大城市的：属于那座生出周边诸镇的母城
words.recall_hint: metro-（母）+ polit（城邦）→ 属于母城、大城的

words.root_logic: spect（看）+ -acular → 值得停下来看的 → 壮观
words.origin: 拉丁语 spectaculum（可观之物），来自 spectare（观看）← specere（看）
words.native_definition: very impressive to look at; strikingly great
words.core_concept: the sight that stops the eye and holds it – 让眼睛停住、挪不开的那种景象
words.core_image: 转过山口，眼前那一片让所有人都收住了脚
semantic_expansions: 壮观的/惊人的：让眼睛停住挪不开的那种
words.recall_hint: spect（看）+ -acular → 值得停下来看的

words.root_logic: spect（看）+ -rum → 呈给眼睛看的那一整条 → 光谱、范围
words.origin: 拉丁语 spectrum（显现、影像），来自 specere（看）
words.native_definition: the band of colours light splits into; a full range of related things
words.core_concept: the whole band laid out for the eye to run along – 摊开来让眼睛一路扫过去的那一整条
words.core_image: 光穿过棱镜，摊出一条从红到紫的带子
semantic_expansions: 光谱：光摊开成的那一条色带
范围/系列：同类事物摊开成的整条幅面
words.recall_hint: spect（看）+ -rum → 呈给眼睛的那一整条

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ spise（看）→ 从上往下看 → 鄙视
words.origin: 古法语 despis-，来自拉丁语 despicere（俯视、轻蔑）← de＋specere（看）
words.native_definition: to feel a strong dislike and lack of respect for
words.core_concept: looking down on a thing from above – 眼光自上往下落在那物上
words.core_image: 他下巴一抬，眼光从鼻梁上头扫过去
examples: She despises gossip of any kind.
semantic_expansions: 鄙视/轻视：眼光自上往下落在那物上
words.recall_hint: de-（往下）+ spise（看）→ 从上往下看

words.root_logic: ir-（不）+ respect（回看顾及）+ -ive → 不回头看那一头 → 不顾、无论
words.origin: 英语 irrespective，由 ir-＋respective ← 拉丁语 respicere（回看）← re＋specere
words.native_definition: not taking something into account; regardless of
words.core_concept: walking on without turning the eye back to it – 眼睛不往那边回一下，照旧往前
words.core_image: 旁边情形如何他一眼没回，脚步照原样走
examples: Open to all, irrespective of age.
semantic_expansions: 不顾的/无论的：眼睛不回看那一头，照旧进行
words.recall_hint: ir-（不）+ respect（回看）→ 不回头看那一头

words.root_logic: bio-（生命）+ graph（写）+ -y → 把一个人一生写下来的那本
words.origin: 希腊语 bios（生命）＋graphein（书写），17 世纪造词
words.native_definition: the written story of a person's life
words.core_concept: one life set down on paper from start to end – 把一个人从头到尾写在纸上
words.core_image: 从出生那页翻到最后一页，全是同一个人的事
examples: She wrote a biography of her father.
semantic_expansions: 传记：把一个人一生写下来的那本
words.recall_hint: bio-（生命）+ graph（写）→ 把一生写下来

words.root_logic: biblio-（书）+ graph（写）+ -y → 把所引各书列写出来的那一份
words.origin: 希腊语 biblion（书）＋graphein（书写）
words.native_definition: a list of the books and sources used in a piece of work
words.core_concept: the roll of every book one leaned on, written out – 把倚仗过的书一本本写成清单
words.core_image: 论文末尾几页，一行一本地列着看过的书
examples: Add the sources to your bibliography.
semantic_expansions: 参考书目/文献目录：把所引各书列写出来的那一份
words.recall_hint: biblio-（书）+ graph（写）→ 把所引各书列写出来

words.root_logic: geo-（地）+ graph（写）+ -y → 把大地描写下来的那门学问
words.origin: 希腊语 geōgraphia（描写大地），来自 gē（地）＋graphein（书写）
words.native_definition: the study of the earth's surface, climate, and peoples
words.core_concept: putting the face of the land down on paper – 把大地的样貌描到纸上
words.core_image: 山川河道一笔笔画进图里，纸上就成了那片地
examples: She teaches geography at the school.
The geography of the region is rugged.
semantic_expansions: 地理/地理学：把大地样貌描写下来的那门学问
地形：某地起伏走势的那副样貌
words.recall_hint: geo-（地）+ graph（写）→ 把大地描到纸上

words.root_logic: tele-（远）+ graph（写）→ 把字写到远处去的那套装置
words.origin: 法语 télégraphe，由希腊 tēle（远）＋graphein（书写）合成，19 世纪造词
words.native_definition: a system for sending messages over distance by electric signal
words.core_concept: writing that lands far from the hand that made it – 手在此处落笔，字却出现在远处
words.core_image: 这头按下几下长短，那头纸带上就吐出一串记号
examples: He sent a telegraph from the port.
semantic_expansions: 电报/电报机：把字送到远处去的那套装置
words.recall_hint: tele-（远）+ graph（写）→ 把字写到远处去

words.root_logic: premere（压）→ preinte（压出的痕）→ 压出字迹 → 印刷
words.origin: 古法语 preinte（压痕），来自 preindre ← 拉丁语 premere（压）
words.native_definition: to produce text or pictures by pressing ink onto paper
words.core_concept: the mark left where something was pressed down – 压下去之后留在那儿的痕
words.core_image: 版子往纸上一压，抬起来时字就留住了
semantic_expansions: 印刷/印：压下去把字留在纸上
字迹：压出来的那些痕
words.recall_hint: premere（压）→ 压出痕迹 → 印刷

words.root_logic: blue（蓝）+ print（压印）→ 蓝底压印出的图 → 蓝图、方案
words.origin: 英语复合词 blue＋print；旧时晒图工艺出蓝底白线，print ← 拉丁语 premere
words.native_definition: a technical drawing of a plan; a detailed scheme
words.core_concept: the pressed-out drawing everything is built from – 压印出来、照着它造的那张图
words.core_image: 摊开那张蓝底的图纸，每根梁的位置都标着
examples: The architect showed us the blueprint.
This is a blueprint for reform.
semantic_expansions: 蓝图/设计图：压印出来、照着施工的那张图
方案：同样作依据的那套设想
words.recall_hint: blue（蓝）+ print（压印）→ 蓝底压印的图

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ press（压）+ -ion → 往回压住 → 镇压、压抑
words.origin: 拉丁语 repressio，来自 reprimere（压回）← re＋premere（压）
words.native_definition: the act of keeping something down by force or by will
words.core_concept: pressing a thing back down so it cannot rise – 把往上冒的按回去，不许起来
words.core_image: 刚要抬头的那一下被一只手按了回去
examples: The repression of protest drew criticism.
Years of repression left their mark.
semantic_expansions: 镇压：用力把动作按回去
压抑/抑制：把情绪或冲动按住不许冒头
words.recall_hint: re-（往回）+ press（压）→ 往回按住不许起

words.root_logic: posit（放定）+ -ive → 已经放定、不再摇摆的 → 确定的、肯定的
words.origin: 拉丁语 positivus（明定的），来自 positus（ponere 的过去分词）
words.native_definition: certain and confident; showing agreement; greater than zero
words.core_concept: set down firmly so it no longer wavers – 已经放定，不再来回移动
words.core_image: 他把那枚棋子按在格里松手，再没挪动过
semantic_expansions: 肯定的/确定的：已经放定、不再摇摆
积极的：心气上同样是定住往前的那一头
words.recall_hint: posit（放定）+ -ive → 放定了不再摇摆

words.root_logic: de-（向下）+ posit（放）→ 往下放好搁着 → 存放、押金
words.origin: 拉丁语 depositum（寄存物），来自 deponere（放下）← de＋ponere
words.native_definition: to put something somewhere for safe keeping; money paid as security
words.core_concept: setting a thing down and leaving it in keeping – 往下放好，就搁在那儿托人看着
words.core_image: 他把袋子往柜台里一放，换回一张凭条
examples: She deposited the cash at the bank.
We paid a deposit on the flat.
semantic_expansions: 存放/存款：往下放好交人看着
押金：先放下作担保的那笔钱
words.recall_hint: de-（向下）+ posit（放）→ 放下搁着托管

words.root_logic: quest（寻求）+ -ion → 为求答案而发出的那一句
words.origin: 古法语 question，来自拉丁语 quaestio（询问）← quaerere（寻找、探求）
words.native_definition: a sentence asked in order to get information; a matter in doubt
words.core_concept: the sentence sent out to fetch an answer back – 抛出去、指望换回一个答案的那句话
words.core_image: 他抛出一句，屋里几个人都抬头等着谁接
examples: There is no question of his honesty.
semantic_expansions: 问题/询问：为求答案而发出的那一句
疑问：尚未有着落、悬着的那一处
words.recall_hint: quest（寻求）+ -ion → 为求答案发出的那句

words.root_logic: question（问）+ -naire（成套）→ 排成一套发出去的问句
words.origin: 法语 questionnaire，来自 question ← 拉丁语 quaerere
words.native_definition: a printed list of questions used to gather information
words.core_concept: a run of asked sentences set out in order to be answered – 一整串问句排开等人逐条作答
words.core_image: 纸上一行一行都留着空格，等着人挨着填
semantic_expansions: 问卷/调查表：排成一套、发出去等人逐条作答的问句
words.recall_hint: question（问）+ -naire（成套）→ 排成一套的问句

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 朝）+ quisit（求得）+ -ion → 求而得之 → 获得、所得之物
words.origin: 拉丁语 acquisitio（获得），来自 acquirere（取得）← ad＋quaerere（求）
words.native_definition: the act of getting something; a thing obtained
words.core_concept: what the seeking finally brings into hand – 一路求下来，终于拿到手的那个
words.core_image: 找了半年，终于把那件东西拿到手里
examples: The painting is her latest acquisition.
semantic_expansions: 获得：求而终于拿到手
收购：以此手段把公司或资产求到手
所得物：求来的那件东西
words.recall_hint: ac-（朝）+ quisit（求得）→ 求而得之

words.root_logic: pro-（往前）+ gress（走）→ 一步步往前 → 进展
words.origin: 拉丁语 progressus（前行），来自 progredi（前进）← pro＋gradi（走）
words.native_definition: movement forward or improvement over time
words.core_concept: one step set down ahead of the last – 一步落在上一步前头
words.core_image: 脚印一个接一个往前排，回头看已走出一段
semantic_expansions: 进展/进步：一步步落在前头、往前推
前进：脚步实际向前那一动
words.recall_hint: pro-（往前）+ gress（走）→ 一步落在前头

words.root_logic: progress（前行）+ -ive → 一路往前走的 → 渐进的、主张改革的
words.origin: 英语 progressive，来自 progress ← 拉丁语 progredi
words.native_definition: happening gradually; favouring reform and new ideas
words.core_concept: keeping the steps coming one after another – 步子一个接一个不停下来
words.core_image: 水位一格一格往上抬，每天都比前一天高一点
semantic_expansions: 渐进的：步子一个接一个不停下来
进步的：主张往前走、求改革的那一头
words.recall_hint: progress（前行）+ -ive → 步子接连不停

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ gress（走）→ 各方走到一处 → 集会、国会
words.origin: 拉丁语 congressus（会合），来自 congredi（走到一起）← con＋gradi（走）
words.native_definition: a formal meeting; the national law-making body of some countries
words.core_concept: steps from many directions ending in one room – 各路脚步走到同一间屋里
words.core_image: 各地的人一路赶来，最后都进了同一间厅
semantic_expansions: 代表大会/会议：各方走到一处开的会
国会：由此制度化而成的立法机构
words.recall_hint: con-（一同）+ gress（走）→ 各方走到一处

words.root_logic: litter（字母、文字）+ -ature → 用文字写成的那一整片 → 文学、文献
words.origin: 拉丁语 litteratura（书写、学问），来自 littera（字母）
words.native_definition: written works valued as art; the writings on a subject
words.core_concept: the body of what has been set down in letters – 用文字写下来、积成的那一整片
words.core_image: 架上一层层排开，全是用字写成的东西
examples: Read the literature on the topic first.
semantic_expansions: 文学/著作：用文字写成、可当艺术看的那些作品
文献：某一题目下写下来的全部材料
words.recall_hint: litter（文字）+ -ature → 用文字写成的那一整片

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ fer（带）+ -ence → 各方把话带到一处 → 会议
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 conferentia，来自 conferre（聚拢、商议）← con＋ferre（带）
words.native_definition: a formal meeting for discussion, often lasting days
words.core_concept: everyone carrying their piece to the same table – 各人把自己那份话带到同一张桌上
words.core_image: 几十个人从各处赶来，把手里的材料摊到一张桌上
examples: She spoke at an international conference.
semantic_expansions: 会议/会谈：各方把话带到一处商议
研讨会：以此形式专议某题目的那种会
words.recall_hint: con-（一同）+ fer（带）→ 各方把话带到一处

words.root_logic: circum-（绕）+ fer（带）+ -ence → 绕一圈带过去的那条线 → 周长
words.origin: 拉丁语 circumferentia（绕行的线），来自 circumferre（环绕）← circum＋ferre
words.native_definition: the distance around the edge of a circle
words.core_concept: the line carried all the way round back to its start – 绕着边一路带回起点的那条线
words.core_image: 笔沿着圆边走一整圈，回到落笔那一点
examples: Measure the circumference of the trunk.
The lake is 5 km in circumference.
semantic_expansions: 圆周/周长：绕边一路带回起点的那条线
words.recall_hint: circum-（绕）+ fer（带）→ 绕一圈带回起点

words.root_logic: inter-（在中间）+ fer（带）+ -ence → 把自己插到中间去 → 干扰
words.origin: 英语 interference，来自 interfere ← 古法语 s'entreferir（互击）← 拉丁 inter＋ferire
words.native_definition: the act of getting involved where one is not wanted; disruption of a signal
words.core_concept: something carried in between so the two can no longer meet cleanly – 有东西插进中间，两头就接不干净了
words.core_image: 两人正说着，第三个人的声音插进中间，谁也听不清了
semantic_expansions: 干涉/妨碍：把自己插到中间去搅一脚
干扰：信号里插进杂物、传不干净
words.recall_hint: inter-（在中间）+ fer（带）→ 插到中间搅一脚
